question: Will Elon Musk's net worth cross $1,500 billion by end of 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the Bloomberg Billionaires Index net worth figure for Elon Musk reaches or exceeds $1,500 billion (i.e., $1.5 trillion) at any daily close strictly after 2026-10-09T10:27:48.383Z and at or before 2026-12-31T18:30:00.000Z.
- "No": Wins if the Bloomberg Billionaires Index net worth figure for Elon Musk remains below $1,500 billion at every daily close strictly after 2026-10-09T10:27:48.383Z and at or before 2026-12-31T18:30:00.000Z.

Clarifications:
- The reference figure is the Bloomberg Billionaires Index end-of-trading-day net worth valuation for Elon Musk, as published on the index's profile page. The Forbes Real-Time Billionaires tracker may be used as a corroborating source where Bloomberg's figure is unavailable for a given date.
